sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Où j’ai reçu le pardon ;
Le fardeau de mon cœur est ôté.
Je ne crains plus, car je suis racheté
Et je chante à celui qui m’a sauvé.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
A mansion is waiting in glory,
My Savior has gone to prepare;
The ransomed who shine in its beauty,
Will dwell in that city so fair.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Oh, home above,
I’m going to dwell in that home;
Oh, home of love,
Get ready, poor sinner, and come.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
A mansion of rest for the weary,
Who toil in the vineyard of love;
O sinner, believe, and be ready
To enter that mansion above.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
A mansion where heavenly music
Enraptures the glorified throng;
They’re singing salvation, O sinner,
Come, join in that beautiful song.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
A mansion where angels are waiting
To welcome the holy and true,
And when to the Savior low kneeling,
They’ll sing a sweet anthem for you.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
A mansion unclouded by sorrow,
Undimmed by the pains of farewell,
Where all of earth’s pilgrims will gather,
With Christ in His glory to dwell.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Oh, home above,
I’m going to dwell in that home;
Oh, home of love,
Get ready, poor sinner, and come.
*

Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.text:
That word above, all earthly powers
No thanks to them abideth.
The Spirit and the gifts are ours,
Through Him who with us siddeth
Let goods and kindred go,
This mortal life also;
The body they may kill,
God's truth abideth still;
His kingdom is forever.

title: A SHELTER IN TIME OF STORM

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
The Lord's our rock, in Him we hide,
A shelter in the time of storm;
Secure whatever ill betide,
A shelter in the time of storm.
Mighty Rock in a weary land,
Cooling shade on the burning sand,
Faithful guide for the pilgrim band-
A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
A shade by day, defense by night,
A shelter in the time of storm;
No fears alarm, no fears affright,
A shelter in the time of storm.
Mighty Rock in a weary land,
Cooling shade on the burning sand,
Faithful guide for the pilgrim band-
A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
The raging storms may round us beat,
A shelter in the time of storm;
We'll never leave our safe retreat,
A shelter in the time of storm.
Mighty Rock in a weary land,
Cooling shade on the burning sand,
Faithful guide for the pilgrim band-
A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
O Rock divine, O Refuge dear,
A shelter in the time of storm;
Be Thou our helper ever near,
A shelter in the time of storm.
Mighty Rock in a weary land,
Cooling shade on the burning sand,
Faithful guide for the pilgrim band-
A shelter in the time of storm.
*

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Am I a soldier of the cross
A follower of the Lamb!
And shall I fear to own his cause,
Or blush to speak His name!

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
In the name,... the precious name,...
Of Him who died for me,
Thro’ grace i’ll win the promised crown,
Whte’er my cross may be!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Must I be carried to the skies
On flow’ry beds of ease,
While others faught to win the prize,
And sailed thro\ bloody seas!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the blood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace,
To help me on to God?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Since I must fight if I would reign,
Increase my courage, Lord!
I’ll bear the toil, endure the pain,
Supported by Thy Word.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text: ABIDE WITH ME

sections.label: Verse 6
Verse 7
sections.text:
Not a brief glance I beg, a passing word;
But as thou dwell’st with thy disciples, Lord,
Familiar, condescending, patient, free.
Come not to sojourn, but abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 8
sections.text:
Come not in terrors, as the King of kings,
But kind and good, with healing in Thy wings,
Tears for all woes, a heart for every plea
Come, Friend of sinners, and thus abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 9
sections.text:
Thou on my head in early youth didst smile;And, though rebellious and perverse meanwhile,Thou hast not left me, oft as I left Thee,
On to the close, O Lord, abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 10
sections.text:
I need Thy presence every passing hour.
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter’s power?
Who, like thyself, my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, Lord, abide with me.
I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness.
Where is death’s sting? Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 11
Verse 12
sections.text: AMAZING GRACE

sections.label: Verse 13
sections.text:
Amazing grace! How sweet the sound,
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found, Was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 14
Verse 15
sections.text: Through many dangers, toils and snares, I have already come;“Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far, and grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 16
sections.text:
The Lord has promised good to me His word my hope secures;
He will my shield and portion beAs long as life endures.

sections.label: Verse 17
sections.text:
Yes, when this heart and flesh shall fail,
And mortal life shall cease,
I shall possess within the veil
A life of joy and peace.

title: ALL HAIL THE POWER OF JESUS’ NAME

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All hail the pow’r of Jesus’ name!
Let angels prostrate fall,
Let angels prostrate fall.
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him, crown Him,
Crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Ye chosen seed of Israel’s race
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him, crown Him,
Crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Let ev’ry kindred, ev’ry tribe,
On this terrestrial ball,
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him, crown Him,
Crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall!
We at His feet may fall!
We’ll join the everlasting song,
And crown Him, crown Him,
Crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
The mighty God is Jesus,
The Prince of peace is He,
The everlasting Father,
The King eternally,
The wonderful in wisdom
By whom all things were made;
The fullness of the Godhead
In Jesus is display’d.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
It’s all in Him, it’s all in Him,
The fullness of the Godhead is all in Him;
It’s all in Him, it’s all in Him,
The mighty God is Jesus, and it’s all in Him.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Emmanuel, God with us,
Jehovah, Lord of hosts!
The Omnipresent Spirit,
Who fills the universe,
The Advocate, the High Priest,
The Lamb for sinners slain,
The Author of redemption;
O glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
The Alpha and Omega,
Beginning and the end,
The Living Word incarnate,
The helpless sinner’s Friend,
Our wisdom and perfection,
Our righteousness and pow’r,
Yes, all we need in Jesus
We find this very hour.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
“Our God from whom we’ve waited”
Will be the glad refrain
Of Israel recreated,
When Jesus comes again;
Lo! He will come and save us,
Our King and Priest to be,
For in Him dwells all fulness,
And Lord of all is He.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
It’s all in Him, it’s all in Him,
The fullness of the Godhead is all in Him;
It’s all in Him, it’s all in Him,
The mighty God is Jesus, and it’s all in Him.
*

title: ALL THE WAY MY SAVIOR LEADS ME

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All the way my Savior leads me.
What have I to ask beside?
Can I doubt His tender mercy,
Who thru' life has been my Guide?
Heav'nly peace, divinest comfort,
Here by faith in Him to dwell!
;For I know, whate’er befall me,
Jesus doeth all things well.;

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
All the way my Savior leads me,
Cheers each winding path I tread;
Gives me grace for ev’ry trial,
Feeds me with the living Bread.
Tho' my weary steps may falter,
And my soul athirst may be,
;Gushing from the Rock before me,
Lo! A spring of joy I see.;

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
All the way my Savior leads me;
Oh, the fullness of His love!
Perfect rest to me is promised
In my Father’s house above.
When my spirit, cloth'd immortal,
Wings its flight to realms of day
;This my song thru' endless ages:
Jesus led me all the way.;
*

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Alleluia! Sing to Jesus!
His the Scepter His the throne;
Alleluia! His the triumph,
His the Victory alone!
Hark! The songs of peaceful
Zion thunder like a mighty flood;
''Jesus out of ev'ry nation has
redeemed us by His blood.''

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Alleluia! Not as orphans
Are we left in sorrow now;
Alleluia! He is near us;
Faith believes, nor questions how.
Though the cloud from sight
received Him when the forty days were o'er,
Shall our hearts forget His promise,
''I am with you evermore''?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Alleluia! Bread of angels,
Here on earth our food, our stay;
Alleluia! Here the humble
Flee to you from day to day.
Intercessor, Friend of sinners, earth's Redeemer, hear our plea
Where the songs of all the sinless sweep across the crystal sea.
*

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Amazing grace! How sweet the sound,
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found,
Was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
“Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Through many dangers, toils and snares,
I have already come;
“Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home."

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When we’ve been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun;
We’ve no less days to sing God’s praise
Than when we first begun.
*

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Savior's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain?
For me who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God shouldst die for me?

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:

That thou my God,
Shouldst die for me?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
He left His father's throne above,
So free, so infinite His grace!
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race!
Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For, O my God, it found out me.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Amazing love! How can it be

Long my imprisoned spirit lay

sections.label: Chorus

Shouldst die for me?

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Appartiens-tu à l’Epouse
De Jésus, notre Seigneur?
Sera-ce pour toi un jour de joie
Ou un jour de frayeur?
Quand il reviendra, ton vêtement
sera-t-il pur et serein?
Oui, c’est l’instant d’être prêt pour le festin.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Maranatha, Alléluia!
Jésus vient, et Son festin est preparé.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Pour celà pourrais-tu rénoncer au Monde et ses plaisirs?
Marches-tu dans la lumière,
Es-tu prêt pour l’acceuillir?
Si tu n’es pas encore libre,
Alors Jésus te dit:”viens!”
Car c’est l’instant
D’être prêt pour le festin.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
L’état mondial nous révèle aussi
Que Jésus vient bientôt.
Lorsque tout va s’accomplir,
Ta délivrance viendra d’en haut.
Dans les ténèbres profondes
Brillera l’Etoile du matin,
Oui, c’est l’instant
D’être prêt pour le festin.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:

guiding me, I can see as I onward go

sections.label: Chorus

Amazing pity, grace unknown,

Well might the sun in darkness hide,

For man, the creature’s sin.

sections.text:
But drops of grief can ne’er repay
The debt of love I owe;
Here, Lord, I give myself away,

often our fathers have sought it

Church of the living God.

Truth of the gospel light.

back to the Master's call

Loving, Obeying them all.
Never in sects to be scattered,
Never again to do wrong;
Unity, holiness, heaven,
Ever shall be our Song.

Holiness unto the Lord"

sections.text:

And the burden of the day.

sections.text:

The very dying form of one

Content to let the world go by.
To know no gain nor loss

My glory all the cross.

(Praise the mount! I’m fixed upon it

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Here I raise my Ebenezer
Hither by Thy help I’m come

Wandering from the fold of God
(He, to rescue me from danger
Interposed His precious blood)

(Here’s my heart, O take and seal it,
Seal it for Thy courts above)

Me to realms of endless day)

Take my life, and let it be

Let them flow inceaseless praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love;
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only for my King,
Take my lips, and let them be
Fill'd with messages from Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Take my silver and my gold
Not amite would I with hold,
Take my intellect and use
Every power as Thou shalt choose.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Take my will, and make it Thine
It shall be no longer mine,
Take my heart it is Thine own,
It shall be Thy royal throne.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
Take my love, my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store,
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee.

Name them one by one,

Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,

What the Lord hath done.

Are you ever burdened
With a load of care?
Does the cross seem
Heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings,
Every doubt will fly,
And you will be
Singing as the days go by.

When you look at others
With their land’s and gold,

Promised you His wealth untold,
Count your many blessings,
money cannot buy
Your reward in Heaven
Nor your Home on high.

sections.label: Chorus

See what God hath done;

title: DANS LE JARDIN OÙ J’AIME ENTRER

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Dans le jardin où j’aime entrer,
À l’heure douce de l’aurore,
Je me rends seul pour rencontrer
Celui que mon âme adore.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Il marche avec moi, mon Sauveur, mon Roi,
Il me dit que je suis à lui.
Il est mon soutien, il est tout mon bien,
Mon salut, mon divin appui.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. Il parle et dans mon cœur,
Sa voix fait naître une joie infinie.
Les oiseaux-mêmes au fond desbois
Suspendent leur mélodie.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. Dans les parterres du jardin,
Les fleurs humides de rosées,
Offrent au visiteur divin,
Leur corbeille parfumée.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
4. Le don que tu cherches Seigneur,
Meilleur que les fruits de la terre,
C’est l’offrande de tout mon cœur,
Elle seule peut te plaire.

title: DANS LE PAYS DE LA GLOIRE ÉTERNELLE

sections.label: Verse 1

c’est le bonheur que je rêve oh ! Jésus.

Sera toujours de te louer Jésus.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:

Dans ton ciel où l’on ne se quitte plus.
Mais pour mon cœur la suprême victoire
Sera d’avoir ton sourire ô Jésus.

Tu brisas ton adversaire

sections.text:

Seul tu peux sauver les âmes.

C’est Toi le rocher des âges.

Tu m’attends dans l’au-delà

sections.label: Verse 4

Gaiement je vous dis adieu
Voici resplendir sur ma route
Le soleil dans un ciel bleu

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Dans ton amour, Divin Sauveur
Toi les délices de ton Père,
Te dépouillant de ta splendeur,
Tu vins t’unir à ma misère !
"Amour divin, le Roi des rois
Pour moi se donne sur la croix" (2x)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. En vain, mon cœur, de ton amour
Voudrait sonder le grand mystère,
Savoir pourquoi tu fus, un jour,
Frappé pour moi sur le calvaire ?
« Sublime amour, don merveilleux
Plus grand que l’infini des cieux » (2x)

meurt ! » (2x)

« Aussi je veux, tout à nouveau,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Day by day, and with each passing moment,
Strength I find, to meet my trials here;
Trusting in my Father’s wise bestowment,
I’ve no cause for worry or for fear.
He Whose heart is kind beyond all measure
Gives unto each day what He deems best
Lovingly, its part of pain and pleasure,
Mingling toil with peace and rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.text:
Help me then in every tribulation
So to trust Thy promises, O Lord,
That I lose not faith’s sweet consolation
Offered me whithin Thy holy Word.
Help me, Lord, when toil and trouble meeting,
E'er to take, as from a Father’s had,
One by one, the days, the moments fleeting,
Till I reach the promised land.

Autour de son trône avec eux

Quand brillera l’aurore
Tous consommés dans l’unité,

A celui qu’on adore
Nous redirons encore,
Digne est l’Agneau de recevoir
Force empire et pouvoir !

mon Roi

je vois.

title: DIEU DUT AIMER UN PÉCHEUR COMME MOI IL A CHANGÉ MA TRISTESSE

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Oh quel merveilleux amour ! (2x)
Que Dieu aima un pécheur tel que moi
Quel est ce merveilleux amour ?

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text: 2. Et Christ s’est donné librement pour moi Cela coûta sa mort sur le calvaire La langue humaine n’a pas de noble thème Comme cet amour qui me sauva.

title: DIEU NOUS AIME COMME UN PÈRE

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1.Dieu nous aime comme un père,
Il écoute nos prières.
Dans les moments difficiles,
Il est notre sûr asile.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:

Face à tous nos adversaires ;
Il nous garde et nous rassure et
Il guérit nos blessures.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3.Dieu nous aime comme un père,
Il nous guide et nous éclaire ;
Jésus Christ est notre frère,
Du péché il nous libère.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
4.Dieu nous aime comme un père,
Sur cette terre étrangère ;
Nos épreuves sont légères
Et nos peines passagères.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Dieu tout-Puissant
Quand mon cœur considère,
Tout l’univers créé par ton pouvoir.
Le ciel d’azur, les éclairs, les tonnerres,
Le clair matin et les ombres du soir.
De tout mon être alors s’élève un chant :
Dieu Tout-Puissant que Tu es grand (2x).

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. Quand par les bois
Ou la forêt profonde,
J’erre et j’entends tous les oiseaux chanter.
Quand sur le mont la source avec son onde,
Livre au zéphyr son chant doux et léger.
Mon cœur heureux s’écrie àchaque instant.
O Dieu d’amour que Tu es grand (2x).

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. Mais quand je songe,
O sublime mystère, Qu’un Dieu si grand a pu penser à moi.
Que son cher Fils est devenu mon frère ;
Et que je suis l’héritier du Grand Roi.
Alors mon cœur redit la nuit le jour
Que Tu es bon O Dieu d’amour (2x).

sections.label: Verse 4

4. Quand mon Sauveur,
Éclatant de lumière,
Rayonnera de sa gloire éternelle.
Et que laissant
Les douleurs de la terre,
Je verrai les splendeurs de son beau ciel.
Je redirai alors la nuit le jour :
Rien n’est plus grand que ton amour.

A friend of Jesus, O what bliss,
That one so vile as I
Should ever have a friend like this
To lead me to the sky.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Friendship with Jesus,
Fellowship divine,
O what blessed, sweet communion,
Jesus is a friend of mine.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
A friend when other friendships cease,
A friend when others fail,
A friend who gives me joy and peace,
A friend when foes assail.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
A friend when sickness lays me low,
A friend when death draws near,
A friend as through the vale I go,
A friend to help and cheer.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
A friend when life’s short race is o’er,
A friend when earth is past,
A friend to meet on heaven’s shore,
A friend when home at last.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Friendship with Jesus,
Fellowship divine,
O what blessed, sweet communion,
Jesus is a friend of mine.

Grace that will pardon and cleanse within;
Grace, grace, God’s grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Hark! A voice divides the sky,
Happy are the faithful dead!
In the Lord who sweetly die,
They from all their toils are freed;
Them the Spirit hath declared blessed,
Unutterably blessed;
Jesus is their great reward,
Jesus is their endless rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Followed by their works,
They go, where their head has gone Before;
Reconciled by grace below,
Grace has opened mercy’s door;
Justified through faith alone,
Here they knew their sins forgiv’n,
Here they laid their burden down,
Hallowed, and made fit for heaven.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Who can now lament the lot of the saints in Christ deceased?
Let the world, who knows us not, call us Hopeless and unblessed:
When from flesh the spirit freed, hastens Homeward to return,
Mortals cry, “A man is dead!” Angels sing, “A child is born!”

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Born into the world above,
They our happy Brother greet,
Bear Him to the throne of love,
Place Him at the Savior’s feet’
Jesus smiles, and says,
“Well done, good and faithful servant thou;
Enter, and receive thy crown,
Reign with Me Triumphant now.”

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Angels catch the approving sound,
Bow, And bless the just awaird;
Hail the heir with glory crowned,
Now rejoicing with His Lord:
Fuller joys ordained to know,
Waiting for The general doom,
When the archangel’s trump shall blow,
“Rise, ye dead, to judgment come!”

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
We read of a place that’s called heaven,
It’s made for the pure and the free;
These truths in God’s Word He hath given,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
How beautiful heaven must be,
Sweet home of the happy and free;
Fair haven of rest for the weary,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
In heaven no drooping nor pining,
No wishing for elsewhere to be;
God’s light is forever there shining,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Pure waters of life there are flowing,
And all who will drink may be free;
Rare jewels of splendor are glowing,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
The angels so sweetly are singing,
Up there by the beautiful sea;
Sweet chords from their gold harps are ringing,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
How beautiful heaven must be,
Sweet home of the happy and free;
Fair haven of rest for the weary,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
How deep the father's love for us! How vast beyond all measure!
That He should give His only Son to make a wretch His treasure!
How great the pain of searing loss! The Father turns His face away.
As wounds which mar the chosen One; Bring many sons to glory.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Behold the man upon the cross! My sin upon His shoulders
Ashamed I hear my mocking voice Call out among the scoffers.
It was my sin that held Him there. Until it was accomplished.
His dying breath has brought me life! I know that it is finished.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I will not boast in anything; No gift, no pow'r no wisdom.
But I will boast in Jesus Christ His death and resurrection.
Why should I gain from His reward? I can not give an answer.
But this I know with all my heart; His wounds have paid my ransom.
*

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:

Honteux, j’entends aussi ma voix S’unir aux cris des moqueurs.
Mon péché l’a cloué au bois, Il dit : Tout est accompli.
Il insuffle sa vie en moi, Ma vie passée est finie.

sections.text:
L’amour du Père est infini, Plus précieux que beaucoup d’or,
Il a donné son fils unique Et fait de nous son trésor.
Tristesse, souffrance sans mesure, Le Père détourne le regard,
Quand de Jésus les meurtrissures Nous font entrer dans sa gloire.

sections.text:
Je ne me vanterai de rien, Ni force, ni sagesse, ni don,

Je n’en comprends pas la raiSon Mais je prends part à son butin,
Pourtant mon cœur en est certain, Il a payé ma rançon.w

Verse 2

And hear the brook And feel the gentle breeze.

sections.text:
And when I think that God, His Son not sparing,
Sent Him to die, I scarce can take it in;
That on the cross, My burden gladly bearing,
He bled and died To take away my sin.

sections.text:
When Christ shall come With shout of acclamation
And take me home, What joy shall fill my heart!
Then I shall bow In humble adoration
And there proclaim, My God, how great Thou art!

things that are nobler,

foes may beset me,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I hear thy welcome voice,
That calls me, Lord, to Thee,
For cleansing in Thy precious blood,
That flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
I am coming, Lord,
Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood
That flowed on Calvary!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Though coming weak and vile,
Thou dost my strength assure;
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse,
Till spotless all and pure.
‘Tis Jesus calls me on
To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust,
For earth and heaven above.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
‘Tis Jesus who confirms
The blessed work within,
By adding grace welcomed grace,
Where reigned the power of sin.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
And He the witness give
To loyal hearts and free,
That ev’ry promise is fulfilled,
If faith but gives the plea.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
All hail, atoning blood!
All hail! Redeeming grace!
All hail! The gift of Christ, our Lord,
Our strength and righteousness

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I know not why God’s wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy, as I am
He claimed me for His own.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
But “I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I’ve committed
Unto Him against that day.”

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I know not how His saving faith
To me He did impart,
Or how believing in His Word
Wrought peace within my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I know not how the Spirit moves,
Convincing men of sin,
Revealing Jesus through the Word,
Creating faith in Him.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me,
Of weary ways or golden days,
Before His face I see.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:

I know not how nor where,
If shall pass the vale of death,
Or “meet Him in the air,”

sections.label: Chorus

And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I’ve committed
Unto Him against that day.”

title: I LOVE TO TELL THE STORY

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I love to tell the Story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love!
I love to tell the Story!
Because I know it’s true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
I love to tell the Story!
‘Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the Old, Old Story,
Of Jesus and His Love!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I love to tell the Story!
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the Story!
It did so much for me!
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I love to tell the Story;
Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems each time
I tell it More wonderfully sweet:
I love to tell the Story;
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God’s own Holy Word.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I love to tell the Story!
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it, like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
‘Twill be the old, old story,
That I have loved so long

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
I love to tell the Story!
‘Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the Old, Old Story,
Of Jesus and His Love!

I must feel His presence near me,

Let Him lead me where He will,

Thro’ the tempest and the sunshine,

sections.text:

I shall know Him

I shall stand;
I shall know Him,

His kindly beaming eye;

I shall know Him

title: I STAND AMAZED IN THE PRESENCE

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I stand amazed In the presence
Of Jesus the Nazarene,
And wonder how He could love me,
A sinner condemned unclean.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
O how marvelous ! O how wonderful !
And my song shall ever be;
O how marvelous ! O how wonderfull !
Is my Saviour's love for me!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
For me it was in the garden He prayed
"not my will, but Thine;" He had no tears
For His own griefs But sweat drops
Of blood for mine.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
In pity angels beheld Him,
And came from The world of light
To comfort Him in the sorrow
He bore for my soul that night.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
He took my sins And my sorrows,
He made them His very own;
He bore the burden to calv'ry,
And suffered And died alone.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
When with the Ransomed in glory
His face I at last shall see,
"Twill be my joy Through the ages
To sing of this love for me."

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
O how marvelous ! O how wonderful !
And my song shall ever be;
O how marvelous ! O how wonderfull !
Is my Saviour's love for me!

sections.text: 2. Le ciel est ouvert à tout être humain, la route est tracée un guide fidèle. Voudrais-tu goûter le parfait bonheur, le ciel est ouvert à tout être humain.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Je suis la lumiere,
A dit le Seigneur;
Avec moi mon frere,
Ouvre Lui ton coeur.
Le monde est plein d'ombre:
Brillons, brillons bien,
Toi dans ton coin sombre,
Et moi dans le mien.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Si la pure flame parfois
Baisse un peu,
Veillons sur notre ame,
Ravivons le feu.
Le monde est plein d'ombre:
Brillons, brillons bien,
Toi dans ton coin sombre,
Et moi dans le mien.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Quand le jour se voile
Au clair firmament,
La plus humble etoile
Brille doucement.
Le monde est plein d'ombre:
Brillons, brillons bien,
Toi dans ton coin sombre,
Et moi dans le mien.

title: JE VEUX PÉCHEUR SAUVÉ PAR GRÂCE

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Je veux pécheur sauvé par grâce,
Exalter Jésus en ce jour.
De son sang dire l’efficace
Chanter son ineffable amour.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Sur la croix Jésus a porté,
Le poids de mes iniquités.
A lui je m’abandonne enfin,
Pour être à ce Sauveur divin.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. Je cherchais, luttais avec larmes,
Je voulais vaincre mais en vain.
Quand lassé je rendis les armes,
La paix brilla sur mon chemin.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. Sur moi posant sa main bénie,
Il me lava complètement.
Et mon âme trouva la vie,
Sa justice est mon vêtement.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
4. Le Prince de paix passe encore,
En cet instant pour me bénir.
Et dans mon âme à lui l’aurore
D’un bon jour qui ne peut finir.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Jerusalem, cité de Dieu
quand pourrais-je franchir ton seuil
et recevoir dans ton saint lieu
de mon sauveur un doux acceuil.
(Jerusalem, city of God, when will I cross your doorsteps
to receive a sweet welcome from my savior in your holy place)

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Plus haut plus loin que l’azur infini,
mes yeux verront mon redempteur beni
dans son palais d’or pur etincelant
ou tout dit gloire, au grand Roi triomphant.
(higher further than the everlasting azure,
my eyes shall see my blessed redeemer
in his pure and sparkling golden palace
All hail glory to the great triumphant king.)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
J’entends des chants harmonieux
des harpes d’or au son si beau
les rachêtés dans les hauts cieux
entonnent le chant de l’agneau.
(I hear melodious songs and golden harps sounding so beautifully
the redeemed in heaven above, singing the song of the lamb.)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
« Etre avec Christ » o saint espoir
le contempler dans sa splendeur
a ses côtés oser m 'asseoir
pour moi, pécheur, rien de meilleur.
(what a holy hope to be with christ, to contemplate him in his splendor
there is nothing better for a sinner such as I, to dare sit next to him).

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Là je verrai tous mes trésors
qu’ici bas j’ai trop tôt perdu
tous revetus d’un nouveau corps
nous louerons le seigneur Jesus.
(I shall see all my treasures up there, that I lost too soon on earth
We will praise the Lord Jesus, all clothed in new bodies )

sections.label: Chorus

in his pure and sparkling golden palace

sections.text:
Jesus lead me up the mountain,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Jesus! source of life eternal,
Jesus! author of our breath
Victor o’er the hosts infernal.
By defeat, and shame, and death.
Thou through deepest tribulation
Deigned to pass for our salvation:
(Thousand, thousand praises be,
Lord of glory, unto Thee.)(2x)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Thou, O Son of God, wert bearing
Cruel mockings, hatred, scorn;
Thou, the King of glory, wearing,
For our sake, the crown of thorn;
Dying, Thou didst us deliver
From the chains of sins for ever:
(Thousand, thousand praises be,
Precious Saviour, unto Thee.)(2x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
All the shame men heaped upon Thee,
Thou didst patiently endure;
Not the pains of death too bitter,
Our redemption to procure.
Wondrous Thy humiliation
To accomplish our salvation:
(Thousand, thousand praises be,
Precious Saviour, unto Thee.)(2x)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Heartfelt praise and adoration,
Saviour, thus to Thee we give;
For thy life humiliation,
For Thy death, whereby we live.
All the grief Thou wert securing,
All the bliss Thy wert securing:
(Evermore the theme shall be
Of thanksgivings, Lord, to Thee.)(2x)
*

title: JESUS, THE LIGHT OF THE WORLD

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All ye saints of light proclaim,
Jesus, the light of the world;
Life and mercy in His name,
Jesus, the light of the world.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
We’ll walk in the light, beautiful light,
Come where the dewdrops of mercy are bright;
Shine all around us by day and by night,
Jesus, the light of the world.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Hear the Saviour’s earnest call,
Jesus, the light of the world;
Send the Gospel truth to all,
Jesus, the light of the world.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Why not seek Him then today,
Jesus, the light of the world;
Go with truth the narrow way,
Jesus, the light of the world.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:

Jesus, the light of the world;
Then the bells of heaven will ring,
Jesus, the light of the world.

sections.label: Chorus

Shine all around us by day and by night,

Verse 2
sections.text:
All Thy works with joy surround Thee,
Earth and heav'n reflect Thy rays,
Stars and angels sing around Thee,
Center of unbroken praise;
Field and forest, vale and mountain,
Flow'ry meadow, flashing sea,
Chanting bird and flowing fountain
Call us to rejoice in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Thou art giving and forgiving,
Ever blessing, ever blest,
Well-spring of the joy of living,
Ocean-depth of happy rest!
Thou our Father, Christ our Brother,
All who live in love are thine;
Teach us how to love each other,
Lift us to the joy divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Mortals, join the mighty chorus,
Which the morning stars began;
Love Divine is reigning o’er us,
Binding all within its span.
Ever singing, march we onward,
Victors in the midst of strife;
Joyful music leads us sunward,
In the triumph song of life.

sections.text:

sections.text:
Louez l’Éternel oh oui car Il est bon
Sa miséricorde durera toujours.
C’est Lui qui rachète l’âme du pécheur
Jamais Il ne le laisse seul et sans secours.

Oui qu’on le célèbre là dans l’assemblée

Sainte délivrance pour tous ses élus,
Car Il manifeste pour eux toute Sa puissance
Pendant que le monde ignore Sa venue

Kutupu ungi witufikija.
Poso’nka Yesu Mupandiji,

Ke ndoe, senene,
Ke ndoe pa kufika mulu.

title: MON CŒUR TRESSAILLE À TA VOIX

sections.text:

sections.text:

sections.text:

Jésus m’a conduit partout

Voyant ma misère,
Il m’ouvre son cœur.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. Mon Sauveur m’aime,
Malgré mon indignité.

Il enlève mon souci,
Son amour immense
Est mon sûr abri.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. Mon Sauveur m’aime
Comme un joyau précieux,
Du diadème, qu’il porte aux cieux. Sa vie éternelle
Il la partage avec moi,
Sa gloire immortelle,
Il l’offre à ma foi.

salvation by my Savior’s name, salvation through His blood.

for me His precious blood He shed, for me His life He gave.

title: MY FAITH LOOKS UP TO THEE

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary,
Savior divine;
now hear me while I pray;
Take all my guilt away,
Oh let, me from this days
Be wholly Thine!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart,
My zeal inspire;
As Thou hast died for me,
O may my love to Thee,
Pure, warm, and changeless be,
A living fire!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
While life’s dark maze I tread,
And griefs around me spread,
Be Thou my Guide.
Bid darkness turn to day,
Wipe sorrow’s tears away;
Nor let me ever stray
From Thee aside.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When ends life's transient dream
When death's cold sullen stream
Shall o'er me roll
Blest Saviour , then in love,
Fear and distrust remove;
Oh, bear me safe above
A ransomed soul.

I will love Thee in life, I will love Thee in death,
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath,

If ever I loved Thee, My Jesus ‘tis now!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Master, the tempest is raging!
The billows are tossing high!
The sky is o’er- shadowed with blackness.
No shelter or help is Nigh.
Carest thou not that we perish?
How canst thou lie asleep
When each moment
so madly is threat’ning a grave in the angry deep?

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
The winds and the waves shall obey thy will: Peace, be still.
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea
Or demons or men or whatever it be,
no waters can swal-low the ship where lies the Master of ocean and earth and skies.
They all shall sweetly obey thy will:
Peace, be still; peace, be still.
They all shall sweetly obey thy will:
Peace, peace, be still

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Master, with anguish of spirit
I bow in my grief today.
The depths of my sad heart are troubled.
Oh, waken and save, I pray!
Torrents of sin and of anguish
Sweep o’er my sinking soul,
And I perish! I perish! dear Master.
Oh, Hasten and take control!

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
The winds and the waves shall obey thy will: Peace, be still.
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea
Or demons or men or whatever it be,
no waters can swallow the ship where lies the Master of ocean and earth and skies.
They all shall sweetly obey thy will:
Peace, be still; peace, be still.
They all shall sweetly obey thy will:
Peace, peace, be still.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Master, the terror is over.
The elements sweetly rest.
Earth’s sun in the calm lake is mirrored,
And heaven’s within my breast.
Linger, O blessed Redeemer!
Leave me alone no more,
And with joy I shall make the blest harbor
And Rest on the blissful shore.

sections.label: Chorus

Pelerin sur cette terre,

Ma route souvent est sombre,
(Mais je suis aime.)(2x)

sections.text:
Aime du plus tendre Pere
Qui m’a conduit en chemin,
Et dirige ma carriere par Sa sure main,
Pendant l’epreuve et l’orage,
Dans l’angoisse et la douleur,
Sa voix me dit:
“Prends courage,
(Je suis ton Sauveur”)(2x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Travailler pour un tel maitre
Le servir en l’attendant,
Apprendre a mieux le connaitre en le contemplant!
Quel bonheur incomparable
Et qu’il est heureux mon sort!
Oui, mon Sauveur adorable
(Me conduit au port!)(2x)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Le port,c’est le doux rivage
Ou cesseront tout nos pleurs.
Ou de Jesus Christ l’image ravira nos coeurs.
Qu’importe donc la souffrance,
Jesus vient! levons les yeux!
Bien pres est la delivrance.
(Ils s’ouvrent les cieux!)(2x)

L’espérance s’affermit.

Come all who hear, Now to His temple draw near;
Join me in glad adoration!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Praise to the Lord, above all things so wondrously reigning,
Sheltering you under His wings, and so gently sustaining.
Have you not seen all that is needful has been
Sent by His gracious ordaining?

sections.text:

Surely His goodness and mercy shall daily attend you.

expiatoire

portes d’or.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Père Saint dont la clémence
Fait briller sur ce beau jour,
La clarté de l’espérance
Avec celle de l’amour,
Veuille dès la première heure
Accorder à ces époux
De tes grâces la meilleure,
De tes bienfaits le plus doux.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. A jamais exauce et scelle
Les vœux qu’ils fontdevant toi,
Garde-les remplis de zèle, Pour ta cause et par ta loi.
Et qu’au cours de leur voyage
Ils connaissent le bonheur
Que reçoivent en partage
Ceux qui t’ont donné leur cœur.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. Que sans cesse à leur prière
Réponde un puissant secours ;
Sois ô Père leur lumière
Aux bons comme aux mauvais jours,
Oui sur tes traces bénies
De l’étroit mais bon chemin
Tiens toujours leurs mains unies
Dans ta sûre et forte main.

sections.text:

Lift high His royal banner;
It must not suffer loss.

Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.text:
Stand up! Stand up for Jesus!
The trumpet-call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict
In this His glorious day!
Ye that are men, now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Your courage rise with danger
And strength to strength oppose.

Stand up! Stand up for Jesus!
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you;
Ye dare not trust your own.
Put on the gospel armour,
Each piece put on with prayer,
Where duty calls; or danger,
Be never wanting there.

sections.label: Verse 4

Stand up! Stand up for Jesus.
The strife will not be long.
This day the noise of battle,
The next the victor’s song.
To Him that overcometh.
A crown of life shall be;
He with the king of glory Shall reign eternally

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Teach me thy way, O Lord,
teach me thy way!
Thy guiding grace afford
teach me thy way!
Help me to walk, a right,
more by faith, less
By sight lead me with
heav'nly light teach me thy way!

sections.text:
When I am sad at heart
teach me thy way!
When earthly joys depart,
teach me thy way!
In hours of loneliness in
times of dire distress
In failure or success
teach me thy way!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
When doubts and fears a rise,
teach me thy way!

teach me thy way

teach me thy way!

the journey's done

teach me thy way!

sections.text:
Blessed be the Fountain of blood,
To a world of sinners revealed;
Blessed be the dear Son of God;
Only by His stripes we are healed.
Though I’ve wandered far from His fold,
Bringing to my heart pain and woe,
Wash me in the blood of the Lamb,
And I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Whiter than the snow!
Whiter than the snow!
Wash me in the blood of the Lamb,
And I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Thorny was the crown that he wore;
And the cross His body overcame!
Grievous were the sorrows He bore
But He suffered not thus in vain;
May I to that Fountain be led,
Made to cleanse my sins here below!
Wash me in the blood that He shed,
And I shall be whiter than snow!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Father, I have wandered from Thee,
Often has my heart gone astray;
Crimson do my sins seem to me_
Water cannot wash them away.
Jesus, to that fountain of Thine,
Learning on Thy promise, I go;
Cleanse me by Thy washing divine,
And I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:

Whiter than the snow!

And I shall be whiter than snow.

The signs that the prophets foretold

Eternity soon will unfold.

Men’s hearts are failing for fear;

Your lamps trimmed and clear,
Look up! your redemption is near.

Verse 3

The day of redemption is nigh.

Spurns God’s revelation,
We’ll walk where the apostles have trod.

sections.label: Chorus

Men’s hearts are failing for fear;
Be filled with the Spirit,
Your lamps trimmed and clear,
Look up! your redemption is near.

title: TÉMOIGNAGE POUR LA GLOIRE DE NOTRE DIEU TOUT-PUISSANT

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Je salue tous les saints de Cape town au Nomde Nôtre Seigneur Jésus-Christ. En ces quelques mots, je viens témoigner de ce que Dieu a fait dans ma vie. Le jeudi 08 septembre 2022, j'étais à la maison entrain de manger et j'étais conduite à suivre le culte qui passait en direct en cette soirée là et c'était le frère Eliezer Kouanga de Brazzaville qui était entrain de prêcher sur le thème : JÉSUS-CHRIST EST LE MÊME HIER, AUJOURD'HUI ET
ÉTERNELLEMENT.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text: Le Saint-Esprit avait parlé en disant que nous sommes appelés à vivre dans l'excellence, Il a dit que nous ne sommes pas appelés à être la queue mais la tête,... Il a parlé en disant que là où tu travailles c'est toi la tête, tu dois attirer même la faveur de ton chef, ton patron doit t'aimer parce que tu crées des bonnes atmosphères.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Un enfant de Dieu dans une société même si les choses ne marchaient pas ça doit marcher parce tu paies régulièrement tes dîmes et le Seigneur fera marcher cette entreprise et j'avais certifié cette parole par amen,
c'est vrai car c'est exactement c'est que j'étais entrain d'expérimenter en ces temps-là. Nous avions 4 mois impayés mais par la grâce de Dieu.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Tous ces mois ont été payés dans un court délai. Et il a continué à dire que
la vie d'un enfant, tu ne resteras pas comme ça, tu dois monter d'échelon en échelon, de prospérité en prospérité, de gloire en gloire, etc.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text: Le frère a dit: j'aimerais qu'à la fin de cet enseignement qu'il y'ait des grands témoignages et moi j'avais cru et certifié par amen et j'avais dis que je témoignerai et ceci je l'avais dis à mes sœurs aussi que je témoignerai. En ces temps, j'aspirai au poste de IT dans notre société et j'avais même déposé ce dossier chez la D.R.H.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text: pendant que j'étais en attente de la suite de ma demande, Notre Dieu a accompli pour moi l'écriture de Esaïe 46 : 11. Il a appelé un homme de la France pour venir accomplir Sa Volonté dans ma vie. Par la grâce de Dieu j'ai été promue à un poste auquel je n'aspirai pas et qui est même au dessus du poste IT auquel j'aspirai.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
Et Dieu a résolu des plus graves problèmes dans notre société.
J'avais promis que je témoignerai et je donne cet témoignage pour la Gloire de Notre Dieu. Que Nôtre Dieu
soit loué à jamais. Yeah He is the same Yesterday, today and forever!!!!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Uzima ninao moyoni daima,

Aliyeingia rohoni hakika,

(The life I have always had in my heart, the life is Jesus the Saviour
who truly came into my spirit, and made me strong.)

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Nashiba rohoni kwa raha ya Mungu,

Napata kukaa nuruni kabisa,

(I am filled with the Spirit of God and the fire of heaven is in it.
I get to be in the light completely, and the light is Jesus the Saviour.)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Baraka zilizo katika wokovu
Nilizozipata kwa bure,
Nilipoungama makosa na dhambi
Kwa Yesu Mwokozi wa wote.
(The blessings in salvation I have received for free,
when I confessed my transgressions and sins to Jesus the Saviour of all.)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Mwokozi aliniondoa porini;
Natunzwa shambani mwa Mungu.
Na sasa kwa mvua na jua la mbingu
Ninamzalia matunda.
(The Saviour took me out of the wilderness,
and I was cared for in God’s garden.
And now by the rain and the sun of heaven
I am bearing fruit for him.)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Naona maisha ni yenye maana:
Ni ku’tumikia Mwokozi.
Kuishi ni Kristo na kufa faida
Kwa kila mkristo wa kweli.
(I see life as meaningful; it is to serve the Saviour.
Living is Christ and dying for the benefit of every true Christian.)

sections.label: Chorus

sections.label: Verse 1

I heard an old, old story,
How a Savior came from glory,
How He gave His life on Calvary
To save a wretch like me;
I heard about His groaning,
Of His precious blood’s atoning,
Then I repented of my sins
And won the victory.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
O victory in Jesus,
My Savior, forever,
He sought me and bought me
With His redeeming blood;
He loved me ere I knew Him
And all my love is due Him,
He plunged me to victory,
Beneath the cleansing flood.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I heard about His healing,
Of His cleansing pow’r revealing,
How He made the lame to walk again
And caused the blind to see;
And then I cried, “Dear Jesus,
Come and heal my broken spirit,”
And somehow Jesus came and brought
To me the victory.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I heard about a mansion
He has built for me in glory,
And I heard about the streets of gold
Beyond the crystal sea;
About the angels singing,
And the old redemption story,
And some sweet day I’ll sing up there
The song of victory.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
O victory in Jesus,
My Savior, forever,
He sought me and bought me
With His redeeming blood;
He loved me ere I knew Him
And all my love is due Him,
He plunged me to victory,
Beneath the cleansing flood.

Cette ville aux mille lumières
Y sera éternellement.

title: VIVANT SUR TERRE DANS CE MONDE PÉCHEUR

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Vivant sur terre dans ce monde pécheur,
Mon âme crie après un consolateur.
Je lutte face aux assauts du tentateur,
Où irai-je si ce n’est qu’à toi Seigneur.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Où irai-je, donc où irai-je ?
Cherchant refuge pour mon âme
en détresse.
Criant secours à mon Sauveur bien-
aimé,
Où irai-je si ce n’est qu’à toi Seigneur.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. J’aime mon prochain et le couve
dans mon cœur,
Nous avançons marchant tous
en harmonie.
Quand mon âme a besoin de ton
pain de vie,
Où irai-je si ce n’est qu’à toi Seigneur.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. La vie est belle, j’ai trouvé
mon trésor,
C’est ta Parole ô Dieu qui me rend
vainqueur.
Si je fais face à la main froide de
la mort,
Où irai-je si ce n’est qu’à toi Seigneur.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
1. Votre cœur soupire-t-il
Après le baptême d’en haut ?
Que le Seigneur a promis
Hâtez-vous de rechercher
Avec ardeur ce don nouveau,
Le baptême de l’Esprit.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Comme un torrent qui déborde sur les rives,
Votre cœur s’inondera
Et de joie se remplira
Vous aurez enfin la fontaine d’eau vive
Jaillissant de votre cœur.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2. Etes-vous un chrétien triste,
Timide et chancelant
Demandez, Dieu donnera
Le remède à tous vos maux
Certainement se trouvera
Dans un baptême puissant.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3. Le Seigneur vous a sauvé
Pour que vous soyez baptisé
D’eau, du Saint-Esprit, de feu
Car il veut que vous puissiez
Aussi Le bénir, l’adorer
En Esprit et en vérité.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
4. Si le Saint-Esprit tarde,
Restez bien ferme dans la foi
Sur les promesses de Dieu
N’ayez aucun interdit
Qui ne soit jugé à la croix
Alors Il descendra du ciel.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
5. Et quand on est baptisé d’en haut
Nageant dans le bonheur
Il faut veiller avec soin,
Que notre ennemi ou le péché
Ne vienne obstruer
Cette source de ferveur.

By and by.

A thousand sacred streets
Before we reach the heavenly fields,
Before we reach the heavenly fields,
Or walk the golden streets,
Or walk the golden streets.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry;
We’re marching thru Immanuel’s ground,
We’re marching thru Immanuel’s ground,
To fairer worlds on high.
To fairer worlds on high.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
We’re marching to Zion.
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We’re marching
Upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Am I a soldier of the cross, A follower of the Lamb,
And shall I fear to own His cause, Or blush to speak His Name?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
And when the battle’s over, We shall wear a crown!
(Yes, we shall wear a crown!)(2x)
And when the battle’s over, We shall wear a crown
In the new Jerusalem.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Wear a crown, wear a crown,
Wear a bright and shining crown,
And when the battle’s over,
We shall wear a crown
In the new Jerusalem.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Must I be carried to the skies On flowery beds of ease,
While others fought to win the prize,
And sailed through bloody seas?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
And when the battle’s over, We shall wear a crown!
(Yes, we shall wear a crown!)(2x)
And when the battle’s over,
We shall wear a crown In the new Jerusalem.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace
To help me on to God?

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
And when the battle’s over,
We shall wear a crown!
(Yes, we shall wear a crown!)(2x)
And when the battle’s over,
We shall wear a crown
In the new Jerusalem.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
Sure I must fight if I would reign,
Increase my courage, Lord;
I’ll bear the toil, endure the pain.

sections.label: Verse 8
sections.text:
And when the battle’s over,
We shall wear a crown!
(Yes, we shall wear a crown!)(2x)

We shall wear a crown
In the new Jerusalem.

We shall wear a crown
In the new Jerusalem.

title: WHAT A DAY THAT WILL BE

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
There is coming a day when no heartaches shall come,
No more clouds in the sky, no more tears to dim the eye;
All is peace forevermore on that happy golden shore,
What a day, glorious day that will be.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
What a day that will be when my Jesus I shall see,
And I look upon His face, the One who saved me by His grace;
When He takes me by His hand, and leads me through the Promised Land,
What a day, glorious day that will be.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
There’ll be no sorrow there, no more burdens to bear,
No more sickness, no pain, no more parting over there;
And forever I will be with the One who died for me,
What a day, glorious day that will be.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
What a day that will be when my Jesus I shall see,
And I look upon His face, the One who saved me by His grace;
When He takes me by His hand, and leads me through the Promised Land,
What a day, glorious day that will be.
*

title: WHAT A FRIEND WE HAVE IN JESUS

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit,
O what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged,
Take it to the Lord in prayer,
Can we find a friend so faithful,
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness,
Take it to the lord in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge,
Take it to the lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the lord in prayer;
In his arms he’ll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.
*

title: WHAT CAN WASH AWAY MY SIN?

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Oh, precious is the flow,
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
For my cleansing this I see,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my pardon this my plea,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
This is all my hope and peace,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
This is all my righteousness,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Now by this I'll overcome,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Now by this I'll reach my home,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
Glory! Glory! thus I sing,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
All my praise for this I bring,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Oh, precious is the flow,
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
*

title: WHAT KIND OF MAN IS JESUS

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
What kind of Man is Jesus,
Hallelujah!
He made the lame to walk,…
He made the deaf to hear,…
He made the dumb to speak,..
He multiplied the bread,…
He multiplied the fishes,…
He rose from the dead,…
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Amen

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Quel est cet Homme de Jésus ?
Alléluia.
Qui marcha sur les eaux,
Qui ressuscite les morts,
Qui guérit les malades,
Qui discerne les cœurs,
Aleluia, Aleluia, Amen

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Muntu ewu Yesu nganyi ?
Alléluia
Wakendela pa mayi,
Wabikisha Lazaro,
Wakondopa babedi,
Wakenza malu mimpe,
Wamba malu, enzeka,
Aleluia, Aleluia, Amen

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Mukalenga wa bakalenga,
Musantu wa basantu,
Mununu wa bikondo,
Tshilongo tsha shalona,
Lubwebwe lwa bikondo,
Mutshimuni mukole,
Tshilobo wa bilobo.
Aleluia, Aleluia, Amen

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Ni nani ule Yesu? Aleluia.
Ana tembea pa maji
Ana fufula bafu
Ana tunza bagonjwa
Aleluia, Aleluia, Amen
*

title: WHEN I GET TO THE END

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
The sands have been washed in the footprints
Of the Stranger of Galilee’s shore,
And the voice that subdued the rough billows,
Will be heard in Judea no more,
But the path of that lone Galilean
With joy I will follow today,

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
And the toils of the road will seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the way,
And the toils of the road will seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the way.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
There are so many hills to climb upward,
I often am longing for rest,
But He who appoints me my pathway,
Knows just what is needful and best,
I know in His word He hath promised
That my strength, “it shall be as my day,”

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
And the toils of the road will seem nothing.
When I get to the end of the way,
And the toils of the road will seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the way.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
He loves me too well to forsake me
Or give me one trial too much,
All His people have been dearly purchased,
And satan can never claim such,
By and by I shall see Him and praise Him,
In the city of unending day,

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
And the toils of the road will seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the way,
And The toils of the road will seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the way.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When the last feeble step has been taken,
And the gates of that city appear,
And the beautiful songs of the angels
Float out on my listening ear,
When all that now seems so mysterious
Will be bright and as clear as the day,

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Then the toils of the road will seem nothing.
When I get to the end of the way,
Then the toils of the road will seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the way.
*

sections.text:

What the Lord has done,
I'll never go back anymore (2x)

No , no, no more,
No , no , no more!

sections.text:
Christ our Redeemer
Died on the cross,
Died for the sinner,
Paid all His due;
Sprinkle your soul
With the blood of the Lamb,

I will pass over you.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:

When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,

sections.text:
Chiefest of sinners,
Jesus will save;
All He has promised,
that will He do;
Wash in the fountain
Opened for sin,
And I will pass,
I will pass over you.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Judgment is coming,
All will be there,
Each one receiving justly his due;
Hide in the saving,
Sin-cleansing blood,
And I will pass,
I will pass over you.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Oh, great compassion !
O boundless love!
O loving kindness,
Faithful and true!

sections.label: Chorus

When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When I survey The wondrous cross,
On which the Prince Of glory died,
My richest gain
I count but loss,
And pour contempt
On all my pride.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Forbid it, Lord,
That I should boast,
Save in the death
Of Christ, my God;
All the vain things
That charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
See, from his head,
His hands, his feet,
Sorrow and love
Flow mingled down,
Did e’er such love
And sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose
So rich a crown?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Were the whole realm
Of nature mine,
That were a present
Far too small;
Love so amazing,
So divine,
Demands my soul,
My life, my all!
*

title: WHEN I THINK OF THE GOODNESS

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When I think of the Goodness of Jesus,
And all He has done for me,
Then my soul cries out Hallelujah!
Praise God for saving me.
*

title: WHEN OUR LORD SHALL COME AGAIN

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text: When upon the clouds of heaven, Christ shall come to earth again, Will the world be glad to see Him, When our Lord shall come again?

sections.text:

There’ll be pain,
There’ll be weeping,

shall come again.

sections.text: Will His coming bring rejoicing? Or the angel’s glad refrain? Are you ready to receive Him, When our Lord shall come again?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Will you join in lamentation?
Or the angel’s glad refrain?
Will you help His people crown Him, When our Lord shall come again?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Work and pray till Jesus calls you, Help to gather in the grain,
Then with joy you’ll meet the Savior, When our Lord shall come again.

sections.label: Chorus

There’ll be singing,
There’ll be shouting,
There’ll be sorrow,
There’ll be pain,
There’ll be weeping,
There’ll be praying,
When our Lord
shall come again.

title: WHEN THE REDEEMED ARE GATHERING IN

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I am thinking of the rapture
In our blessed home on high,
When the redeemed are gathering in;
How we’ll raise the heavenly anthem
In that city in the sky.
When the redeemed are gathering in.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When the redeemed are gathering in,
Washed like the snow,
And free from all sin;
How we will shout,
And how we will sing,
When the redeemed are gathering in.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
There will be a great procession over
On the streets of gold,
When the redeemed are gathering in;
O what music, O what singing,
O’er the city will be rolled,
When the redeemed are gathering in.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Saints will sing redemption’s story
With their voices clear and strong.
When the redeemed are gathering in;
Then the angels all will listen,
For they cannot join that song,
When the redeemed are gathering in.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Then the Savior will give orders
To prepare the banquet board,
When the redeemed are gathering in;
And we’ll hear His invitation,
"Come, ye blessed of the Lord.’’
When the redeemed are gathering in.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When the redeemed are gathering in,
Washed like the snow,
And free from all sin;
How we will shout,
And how we will sing,
When the redeemed are gathering in.

title: WHEN THE ROLL IS CALLED UP YONDER

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound, and time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I’ll be there.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:

When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
I’ll be there.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
On that bright and cloudless morning when the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share;
When His chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder, I’ll be there.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Let us labor for the Master from the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care;
Then when all of life is over, and our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder, I’ll be there.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,

title: WHEN THE SAINTS GO MARCHING IN

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I’m a pilgrim and a stranger
Wand’ring through this world of sin,
On my way to that fair city,
When the Saints go marching in.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When the saints go marching in,
When the saints go marching in,
Lord, I want to be in that number
When the saints go marching in.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Oh, I know I’ll see my Saviour
If my life is free from sin,
Heaven’s doors will open for me
When the Saints go marching in.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
When we gather ‘round the Throne
And the gates are closed within,
I’ll be shouting “Glory, Glory”
When the Saints go marching in.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I’m waiting for the chariot
To swing low and I’ll step in,
On the clouds I’ll ride to Heaven
When the Saints go marching in.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When the saints go marching in,
When the saints go marching in,

title: WHEN WE ALL GET TO HEAVEN

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions, bright and blessed,
He’ll prepare for us a place.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus,
We’ll sing and shout the victory.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
Clouds will overspread the sky;
But when trav’ling days are over,
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Let us then be true and faithful,
Trusting, serving, every day;
Just one glimpse of him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Onward to the prize before us!
Soon his beauty we’ll behold;
Soon the pearly gates will open,
We shall tread the streets of gold.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus,
We’ll sing and shout the victory.
*

title: WHEN WE WALK WITH THE LORD

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When we walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Trust and obey,
For there’s no other way
To bring glory to Jesus
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Not a shadow can rise,
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt or a fear,
Not a sigh of a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay,
Not a grief or a loss,
Not a frown or a cross,
But is blest if we trust and obey!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
But we never can prove,
The delights of His love,
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favor He shows,
And the joy He bestows,
Are for them who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Then in fellowship sweet
We will sit at His feet,
Or we’ll walk by His side in the way!
What He says, we will do,
Where He sends, we will go
Never fear, only trust and obey!

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Trust and obey,
For there’s no other way
To bring glory to Jesus
But to trust and obey.
*

But to the Lord

The chilling hand of death,
Where could I go? But to the Lord

sections.label: Chorus

sections.text:

built by Jesus on high, there we never shall die,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Far away in the depth of my spirit tonight
Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
In celestial-like strains it unceasingly falls
O’er my soul like an infinite calm.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Peace! peace! wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above;
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray,
In fathomless billows of love.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
What a treasure I have in this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in the heart of my soul;
So secure that no power can mine it away,
While the years of eternity roll.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I am resting tonight in this wonderful peace,
Resting sweetly in Jesus’ control;
For I’m kept from all danger by night and by day,
And His glory is flooding my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Ah! Soul, are you here without comfort and rest,
Marching down the rough pathway of time?
Make Jesus your friend ere the shadows grow dark;
Oh, accept this sweet peace so sublime.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Peace! peace! wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above;
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray,
In fathomless billows of love.

- Y'osopaki makila na Yo
Mpo na bango.
Bazali bana na Yo.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
2- Nkolo Yesu pambola,
Ah ! Yaweh pambola.
- Nzambe na ngai pambola,
Ah ! Yaweh pambola.
- Nkosi na Yuda pambola,
Ah ! Yaweh pambola.
- Pambola bandeko mibali,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bandeko basi,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bateyi na Yo,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bateyi nionso,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bakeluba,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bampaka nionso,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bana mike,
Pambola bango.
- Pambola bapetit nionso,
Pambola bango.
- Nkolo na leleli Yo,
Pambola bango.
- Nkolo na sambeli Yo,
Pambola bango.
- Nkolo na bondeli Yo,
Pambola bango.
- Pesa bango kimia,
Pambola bango.
- Pesa bango bwanya,
Pambola bango.
- Bwanya oyo ya Lola,
Pambola bango.
- Sopa Molimo na Yo,
Kati na bango.
- Babatela Liloba oyo,
Sanduku na Yaweh.
- Babatela Message,
Toli ya mosakoli.
- Y'osopaki makila na Yo
Mpo na bango.
Bazali bana na Yo.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
3- Eh, eh, pambola,
Eh, eh pambola.
- Oh, oh, pambola,
Oh, oh, pambola.
- Ih, ih, pambola,
Ih, ih, pambola.
- Ah, ah, pambola,
Ah, ah, pambola.
